description: Deletes a conversation, as the thread menu's Delete does (an admin or owner seat; a member seat is refused): its emails, texts and calls move to each contact's own thread first, so nothing is lost, and only the empty shell goes. Refused when a record on it has no contact to move to. It cannot be undone; merge_conversations keeps the content in one thread instead. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the first result.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: delete_conversation
title: Delete an empty or duplicate conversation
